definitions.explanation: The grammatical rules and structures of the English language. A common subject in Japanese education from junior high school onward.

examples.japanese: {英文法|えいぶんぽう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
{英文法|えいぶんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an English grammar reference book.
